## Purpose

The semantic layer maps natural-language clinical trial design requests to
normalized trial-design intent and then to package-specific workflows.

It is intentionally lightweight:

- shared vocabulary in `glossary/`
- package crosswalks in `crosswalks/`
- router and glossary skills in `.agents/skills/`
- routing examples in `evals/`
